note: Source: QU Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027 (current/authoritative), cross-checked against the 2024 CS Program Roadmap flowchart. Where they conflicted, the 2026-2027 catalog was used (e.g. Senior Project is now CMPS 493/CMPS 499, not CMPE 493 as in the 2024 flowchart/older data). One exception: the Year 2 Spring Arabic requirement is ARAB 100 (not the catalog's printed ARAB 200), corrected per a current CS student's direct confirmation that the catalog entry is an error. Generic package requirements (Social/Behavioral Sciences, Natural Science/Mathematics, Humanities/Fine Arts, Core Knowledge and Skills packages) are degree requirements but not modeled as specific courses here since students choose from a pool — not invented/guessed. Total required credits per catalog: 120.

electives.note: Major Electives Courses (12 CH) — student picks courses totaling 12 credit hours from this pool. Prerequisites shown are from the catalog's course listing (Chapter 11) but not resolved against this program's completed-course logic.
